error_detail.note: datasheet RDRXCTL bits 27-31 are Reserved; Drop_En is an SRRCTL field at bit 28. Mis-split of the Reserved 31:27 span (accounts for 3 of the 4 POS_FLAGs: Reserved 27:27, Drop_En 28:28, Reserved 31:29).
datasheet SRRCTL ends Drop_En 28 + Rsv 31:29; no VME. VME is an RXDCTL field bled in.

false_flags.EIAM_x4: parser bleed from EICS/EIMS/EIMC (section bound); EIAM extracted correctly (Auto Mask 30:0)
false_flags.GOTCH_x2: parser bleed from neighbouring stats counters; GOTCH extracted correctly (CNT_H 3:0)

recall_caveat.LINKS: datasheet documents LINKS with two overlapping field tables (config-write view: ANPDT/RF/PB/KX_support @25-31; status-read view: full 0-31). Extraction captured the status view; 3 config-view fields (ANPDT, RF, KX_support) unrepresented.

adjudication.pattern: both genuine errors are spurious named fields bled into Reserved regions from adjacent Rx-DMA registers (RDRXCTL<->SRRCTL<->RXDCTL), consistent with full-page completion-pass context mixing neighbouring register tables; 0 real named fields mispositioned.
